measurement: Original ChatGPT desktop system-browser sign-in handoff

source.defaultBrowser: original Debian system Chromium, fresh profile, delivered via an ephemeral XDG desktop handler on the same display and private network namespace

action: Click the original Continue to sign in button once with a pointer. The XDG default browser receives the application-generated URI. Only scheme, host, path and protocol shape were recorded.

onlineScope.developmentEnvironment: An independent public-origin handshake through the configured development proxy returned an internal certificate chain. With only Ubuntu Mozilla public roots, certificate verification failed. The managed environment also refused direct TCP/443. No trust store or egress policy was changed.
notYetVerified: A policy-approved cloud egress connection to the real vendor sign-in page
The separate original browser surface rendered and controlled in the Windows desktop
Completing authorization, returning to the original app, and authenticated conversation UI
